title: Direct question-to-win detection and faster Flagdle geographic clues
body:
- Asking directly about the mystery country (e.g. "Is it Croatia?" or "Croatia?") now immediately scores as a winning guess when correct, finishing the game on the spot without deducting a question turn or requiring retyping.
- Incorrect country questions still count as regular questions without penalizing your limited guess attempts.
- Flagdle clues now unlock much faster: distance in kilometers appears starting on guess 3, and compass direction arrows unlock on guess 5.
- Your saved game progress, daily streaks, and normal game limits are unchanged.
